description: This file contains the implementation of the CosmosMembershipTable class, which manages cluster membership data in Azure Cosmos DB for Orleans. It includes methods for initializing the database, reading, inserting, updating, and deleting silo membership entries, as well as handling cluster versioning and silo health updates.

classes.name: CosmosMembershipTable
classes.description: A class implementing IMembershipTable that stores and manages cluster membership data in Azure Cosmos DB, including silo registration, health updates, and versioning.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the Cosmos DB client, creates resources if enabled, and ensures the cluster version entity exists.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries and cluster version info for a given cluster ID.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silo entries marked as dead before a specified date.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific silo's membership data by its address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all silo membership entries and the cluster version.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a new silo membership entry with a specified table version.

methods.name: UpdateRow
methods.description: Updates an existing silo membership entry with optimistic concurrency control.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a silo.

methods.name: InitializeCosmosClient
methods.description: Creates and initializes the Cosmos DB client.

methods.name: TryDeleteDatabase
methods.description: Attempts to delete the Cosmos DB database if it exists.

methods.name: TryCreateCosmosResources
methods.description: Creates the Cosmos DB database and container with appropriate indexing policies.

methods.name: ReadClusterVersion
methods.description: Reads the cluster version entity from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: ReadSilos
methods.description: Queries silo entities from Cosmos DB, optionally filtered by status.

methods.name: ConstructSiloEntityId
methods.description: Constructs a unique ID for a silo entity based on its address.

methods.name: ParseEntity
methods.description: Converts a SiloEntity document from Cosmos DB into a MembershipEntry object.

methods.name: ConvertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a MembershipEntry into a SiloEntity document for Cosmos DB.

methods.name: BuildVersionEntity
methods.description: Creates a ClusterVersionEntity from a TableVersion.
